messagingGuides.documentName: [EXTERNAL] OpenShift Virtualization with Cohesity Messaging Guide
messagingGuides.summary: This messaging guide outlines the key benefits and messaging for the integrated solution of OpenShift Virtualization with Cohesity DataProtect. It focuses on how this collaboration enhances data resiliency, streamlines operations, and provides robust data protection for modern virtualized environments.
keyPoints: Cohesity DataProtect and Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization provide a unified, scalable platform for migrating VMs, enabling modernization and consistent management across hybrid cloud environments.
The solution significantly improves operational efficiency and scales for data protection through centralized management, a scalable architecture, and automated workflows.
It ensures data is properly protected and quickly restorable, offering advanced ransomware protection, compliance and governance features, and future instant mass restore functionality.
The integrated offering provides consistent data management and protection across environments with optimized performance and unified protection for VMs and containerized applications.
Differentiators against competitors like Commvault, Rubrik, and Veeam include superior cybersecurity capabilities, ease of management, reduced storage, and advanced ransomware recovery.
